svg.title: Dream House coordinated upper-floor plan
svg.desc: An upper-floor revision prioritizing the primary suite, relocating laundry to PB and reserving a retractable exterior stair. Not for construction.
svg.metadata: {"construction_authority":false,"drawing":"DH-ARQ-PLN-002-R11","model_sha256":"0fcb66c4d3d0076dc99fad596acf5b3e4be51133c9e249771d9d3a1bf032ecae","revision":"0.3-draft-14-P2","status":"issued for coordination under D-058; not for construction"}
svg.text: D-058 continuous hall-edge enclosure + D-057 wall control
P2 PLAN · 18.00 x 15.00 m · +3.80 m STUDY LEVEL

text.tspan: Prioritize the primary suite without enlarging P2.
Move laundry into PB storage behind the Great Wall.
Protect the view while allowing one large exposed industrial truss.
Coordinate dry P2 partitions at 250 mm nominal under D-057.
Close the full X=21 hall/workshop edge under D-058.

svg.text: Bathroom 17.6 m2 + dressing/filter 17.6 m2 meet the brief.
Washer, dryer and sink move to PB storage behind the Great Wall.
A theft-resistant retractable exterior-stair envelope is reserved.
Mini-deck sightline governs the single large X=21 truss.
Four D-048 column reservations remain at stair corners.
P2-W01 + continuous P2-W04: 250 mm opaque wall; only deck glazing interrupts.
A rear retractable stair is reserved, but its acceptance as a second exit awaits D-021 and professional fire review
The large exposed X=21 truss must preserve the mini-deck view; members, joints, fire protection and services remain undesigned
Solar control, privacy and final glazing await the selected site and orientation
W04 is full-height; GLZ-DECK is its only planned opening.
D-058 · CONTINUOUS X=21 ACOUSTIC ENCLOSURE · DESIGN COORDINATION
Current architectural coordination hypothesis. It does not authorize procurement, fabrication or construction.
